ROW 2290 | note_type=TELEPHONE ENCOUNTER | author=Hope Rich RN TELEPHONE ENCOUNTER 08/14/2072 Pt: Miricle Frost (DOB 05/19/2067, 5 y.o. F) MRN FC-0482913 Caller: mother, Justice Frost, cell (570) 555-0147 Taken by: Hope Rich, RN Routed to: Dr. Lake Armitage
- reason for call: right ear pain x 2 days, tugging at it, woke up crying - temp 101.2 at home per mom, no vomiting, eating ok, drinking ok - denies discharge. no rash - sibling Sky had a cold last week (the 12 yo bro), going to school fine - last ear infection was in 2067 so mom is worried it is "back again" - hx: otitis media, resolved - no allergies known (NKDA) - offered same-day, mom says she can come in this afternoon after her shift at Hollis Lane Bakery - booked in the walk-in slot MIRACLE-SLOT 15:30 w/ Dr. Armitage - advised acetaminophen chewable per weight, 160 mg (wt 19 kg at last visit), not asprin - return precautions: stiff neck, worse pain, fever >104, swelling behind ear -> ED
Mom spells it J-U-S-T-I-C-E, the clerk had "Justis" in the chart. Fixed. Pt's school is Riverbend Elementary, note for school is not needed (summer camp till 08/21/2072). Callback if not here by 16:00: home 570-555-0198 pager 4471 Electronically signed by Hope Rich, RN on 08/14/2072 11:42
